newsitem.title: USA: Redwood Financial ends Olivia talks.
newsitem.headline: Redwood Financial ends Olivia talks.

text.p: Redwood Financial Inc on Monday said it terminated its letter of intent to acquire Olivia Bancorp Inc and no further negotiations between the companies will be held in the foreseeable future.
Redwood said that upon completion of due diligence, its board of directors could not offer the price disclosed in the letter of intent, and the two could not agree upon a revised price.
Olivia owns 97.6 percent of the outstanding stock of American State Bank of Olivia, Minn., Redwood said.
On November 4, Redwood said it had signed a letter of intent to acquire Olivia for about $4.38 million in cash. It said American State Bank had assets of $28.9 million.
Redwood Financial is the holding company of Redwood Falls Federal Savings and Loan Association, which has $51.1 million in total assets.
